summary: First Majestic Silver filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated November 12, 2026, reporting positive near-surface exploration drill results at its Jerritt Canyon Gold Mine in Nevada and an update on restart progress. Highlights include 48.8 m grading 4.24 g/t Au and 36.6 m grading 5.87 g/t Au at Saval, supporting potential open-pit mill feed alongside underground mining. The 2026 program has completed 15,983 m across 146 holes, with assays pending, and management targets a restart in H2 2027. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisors are stated.
